description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (1.50 each), grants [Switch Draw Mode II (Wind, Dark)], [Awoken Spellstrike], [Damage Cap +10000], [Wind, Dark Ability +30% Boost (15s)] and [(Wind/Dark) Ability Instant Cast 2] to the user

description.name: Switch Draw Mode II (Wind, Dark)
description.text: Grants [Attach Wind with Stacking]/[Attach Dark with Stacking] after using a Wind/Dark ability

description.name: Awoken Spellstrike
description.text: Wind and Dark abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Wind and Dark abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Wind, Dark Ability +30% Boost (15s)
description.text: Wind or Dark abilities deal 30% more damage

description.name: (Wind/Dark) Ability Instant Cast 2
description.text: Instant cast speed for Wind and Dark abilities
